title: GenAITEd Ghana: A First-of-Its-Kind Context-Aware and Curriculum-Aligned Conversational AI Agent for Teacher Education

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of human expert feedback to evaluate the system's cultural embeddedness, contextual appropriateness, and mitigation of Western-centric epistemic asymmetry in educational AI.

Functional testing of multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS) models for local Ghanaian dialects, combined with expert evaluation of the platform's linguistic inclusivity.
